A paragraph; with only `title` set, the title-block chrome contains
`<h1 class="title">` plus the (empty) `quarto-title-meta` grid div —
Q1 parity emits the grid whenever the title block renders
(bd-gx9cic8z P1). No subtitle, author/date cells, or abstract.
